Create a standalone Shiny app for the michaelisMenten module

Source: R/michaelisMentenPlot_module_app.R
michaelisMentenApp.Rd

This function generates a Shiny application with the modular Michaelis-Menten plotting components: an inputs panel for configuring the plot and an output panel showing the interactive plotly figure.

Usage

michaelisMentenApp(
  data = NULL,
  model = NULL,
  stats = NULL,
  defaults = NULL,
  hide.inputs = NULL,
  hide.tabs = NULL,
  title = "Modular Michaelis-Menten Plot"
)

Arguments

data

The plotting data frame of observed points. If NULL (the default), the bundled mm_kinetics is used, with mm_kinetics_line as model and mm_kinetics_fit as stats.

model

A data frame of fitted-line coordinates (e.g. mml) sharing the same x/y columns as data. Required when data is given.

stats

Optional fitted model (e.g. an nls fit of v ~ Vm * S / (K + S)) or named coefficients from which K and Vmax are extracted for annotation. NULL (the default, when data is given) disables the annotation.

defaults

An optional named list of default input values, applied over the gallery's settings when the example data is used.

hide.inputs

A character vector of input IDs to hide. Their values are still initialized and used, but the controls are not shown in the UI.

hide.tabs

A character vector of tab names to hide. Inputs in these tabs are still initialized and used.

title

The app title.

Value

A Shiny app object.

Details

Unlike the upload-driven VizModules::createModuleApp() wrapper, this app takes the three data inputs directly because the module needs more than a single data frame: the observed data, the fitted line, and (optionally) the stats object used for K / Vmax annotations.

When called with no arguments, the app launches with the bundled example kinetics data (mm_kinetics, mm_kinetics_line, and mm_kinetics_fit), on the settings the module gallery (sciModuleGalleryApp()) opens this module on.

See also

michaelisMentenInputsUI(), michaelisMentenOutputUI(), michaelisMentenServer(), michaelisMentenPlot()

Author

Jacob Martin

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
# Launch with the bundled example kinetics data:
app <- michaelisMentenApp()
if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app)

# Launch with custom data:
data(mm_kinetics)
if (requireNamespace("drc", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(drc)
    mm_model <- drm(v ~ S, data = mm_kinetics, fct = MM.2())
    mml <- data.frame(S = seq(min(mm_kinetics$S), max(mm_kinetics$S), length.out = 100))
    mml$v <- predict(mm_model, newdata = mml)
    stats <- nls(v ~ Vm * S / (K + S), data = mm_kinetics,
        start = list(K = max(mm_kinetics$v) / 2, Vm = max(mm_kinetics$v)))
    app2 <- michaelisMentenApp(mm_kinetics, mml, stats)
    if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app2)
}
